title: HumanCentric-Scenes-AI: A Human-Curated Multimodal Dataset of AI-Generated Human-Centric Scenes Across Surveillance, Occupational Portraits, AI-Edited Images, and Short-Form Video
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset for evaluating human perception and AI detection of generated media, and investigates demographic (gender) bias in generative text-to-image models. It does not evaluate or benchmark topics related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
